text: Bitcoin is essentially flat while Ethereum shows mild strength, suggesting uneven confidence across the major assets as fear sentiment remains extreme. BTC dominance holding steady at 56.2% despite the price stall indicates money hasn't rotated dramatically toward alts, though the modest $69B volume reflects cautious participation overall. The Fear & Greed index rising 3 points from a deeply oversold level hints at early stabilization, but conviction remains fragile.
